events.title: Hive mind
events.text: Two hives, 100,000 bees, backyard honey.

effects.tpl: Sixty jars yearly. The garden explodes with pollination.
A season apprenticing. Stings: three. Knowledge: total.

events.title: The memoir
events.text: Your stories deserve pages. Mornings are free.

effects.tpl: 70,000 words. The family fights over chapters.
Recorded tales, printed hardcover. Immortality: achieved.

events.title: Brick oven
events.text: A backyard brick oven: weekends of fire and flour.

effects.tpl: Sixty-second pizzas. The neighborhood invents reasons to visit.
You master dough before mortar. The oven earns its keep.

events.title: Second roof
events.text: A small lake cabin lists low. The family votes yes unanimously.

effects.tpl: Docks, loons, cousins every July. The family anchor drops.
Two weeks yearly, zero roofs to fix. Freedom kept.

events.title: The long walk
events.text: Five hundred miles across an old country. Feet willing?

effects.tpl: Blisters, albergues, sunrise over the meseta. Changed, forever.
The last hundred miles. The compostela still counts. Joy: total.

events.title: Peak leverage
events.text: Twenty years in. The next five decide the last fifteen.

then.tpl: Title, pay, flexibility: all three. 15,000 dollars more.

else.tpl: Modest bump, better hours. The negotiation still moved you.

effects.tpl: Three proteges rise. Your legacy compounds.

events.title: Park tables
events.text: The park chess tables host sharks and philosophers.

effects.tpl: You take two of five from the old master. Respect exchanged.
Twelve kids, plastic sets, infinite rematches.

events.title: Lead the choir
events.text: The choir director retires. Eyes turn to you.

effects.tpl: First concert: full house, standing ovation, tears.
You anchor the section while the new leader learns.

events.title: Orchard rows
events.text: Ten rows of old apples lease cheap. Cider math works.

effects.tpl: Farmers markets, festivals, 5,200 dollars of autumn.
Deer, bees, kids: the orchard feeds all. Cider for friends.

events.title: Town board
events.text: The planning board needs a sane voice. Meetings are Tuesdays.

effects.tpl: Three years of zoning. The town improves because you showed up.
You champion the park bond. It passes by 40 votes.

events.title: Tuition era
events.text: Tuition bills arrive like weather. Four years of them.

effects.tpl: Year one covered. The 529 and salary split the rest.
Two years local, then transfer. Diploma identical, debt halved.

events.title: Family cookbook
events.text: Recipes scattered across cards and memory. Bind them.

effects.tpl: Fifty copies, gravy stains incoming. Christmas: solved forever.
Hands filmed mid-knead. Technique and love preserved.

events.title: Coast century
events.text: The coastal century: 100 miles of cliffs and tailwinds.

effects.tpl: Mile 80 breaks you; mile 100 rebuilds you. Medal earned.
Metric century, full joy. The cliffs applaud.

events.title: Giving away
events.text: Your child marries. You hold it together until the dance.

effects.tpl: Perfect day. The first dance breaks you beautifully.
Backyard vows, forty people, all heart. They prefer it.

events.title: Agility era
events.text: The dog needs a job. Agility tunnels glow under lights.

effects.tpl: Weaves, jumps, zoomies. Ribbons multiply on the fridge.
The dog finds every hide. Sniffer genius confirmed.

events.title: Last bedroom
events.text: The youngest packs for college. The house exhales.

effects.tpl: Guest room plus studio. Grief becomes a gym and a guest bed.
Monthly visits, full fridge. They always come back.

events.title: Legacy papers
events.text: Wills, trusts, letters. The paperwork of forever.

effects.tpl: Trusts funded, letters sealed. The future is organized.
Letters to each child, written crying. The lawyers can wait.

events.title: Festival crew
events.text: The film festival needs venue captains. Films included.

effects.tpl: Sold-out shows run on your headset. Directors thank you.
Your ballot backs the winner. Taste: validated.

events.title: Silver muzzles
events.text: Senior dogs need soft landings. Your couch qualifies.

effects.tpl: Gus stays. Gray muzzles give the deepest love.
You fund vet care for three fosters. Heroes, all adopted.

events.title: Half century club
events.text: Friends turn fifty in waves. Parties stack up.

effects.tpl: Six parties, six toasts, one year of friendship.
Your party sets the standard. The slideshow slays.

events.title: Fairway era
events.text: Everyone plays golf suddenly. The invitation stands.

effects.tpl: Respectable bogeys. Deals and jokes flow on the cart paths.
You walk, they ride. Nine miles of thinking per round.

events.title: Kids grown tour
events.text: The nest empties. The map opens. Where first?

effects.tpl: Bullet trains, old temples, new flavors. You hold hands like teens.
Every park you missed. Hiked at last, together.

events.title: Camp grandma
events.text: Grandkids descend for a week. The house becomes a fort.

effects.tpl: Crafts, creeks, stories. They leave chanting your name.
One perfect zoo day. Quality over quantity wins.

events.title: Full workup
events.text: Fifty approaches. The full screening is due.

effects.tpl: All clear, plus a plan. Knowledge is the best medicine.
Bloodwork and pressure first. Baselines banked.

events.title: Docent days
events.text: The historic house needs guides. You know every story.

effects.tpl: Victorian gossip delivered with flair. Visitors rave.
You find the lost letters. The tour gains a ghost.

events.title: Five acres
events.text: Five acres lists at the edge of town. Chickens are inevitable.

effects.tpl: Goats, hens, orchard rows. Mornings smell like purpose.
A big garden plot first. Farming trial: passed.

events.title: Combo nights
events.text: A community jazz combo needs your instrument. Charts provided.

effects.tpl: Blue bossa under lights. Solos grow braver monthly.
Comping mastered. The soloists love you.

events.title: Stair report
events.text: The knee comments on every stair. It wants a meeting.

effects.tpl: Twelve sessions. Stairs become stairs again.
Swim, bike, row. The knee approves; fitness persists.

events.title: Third tongue
events.text: Retirement dreams include another country. Its language first.

effects.tpl: Ordering, joking, dreaming: all in the new tongue.
Three weeks there. Fluency leaps; so does joy.

events.title: Maker nights
events.text: The maker space has lasers, looms, and patient teachers.

effects.tpl: Cut, etched, inlaid. Gifts become legendary.
Your safety class fills. Zero injuries, many stools.

events.title: Qualifier chase
events.text: The qualifying time is four minutes away. One training cycle.

then.tpl: Qualified! The jacket fits like destiny.

else.tpl: Missed by ninety seconds. Next cycle: yours.

effects.tpl: No watch, all views. Running remembered as play.

events.title: Gray hair capital
events.text: Founders want your scar tissue. Advisory shares offered.

effects.tpl: Three startups, real equity. One pays like a lottery.
Your operator course fills. Hundreds learn your hard lessons cheap.

events.title: Two wheels
events.text: The motorcycle itch arrives on schedule. The course is safe and fun.

effects.tpl: Licensed, geared, careful. Sunday rides heal everything.
Two rentals, all thrill, zero garage. Itch scratched.

events.title: First opera
events.text: Subtitles, drama, voices bigger than weather.

effects.tpl: Four operas, one obsession. The final aria wrecks you.
Wigs, trapdoors, 200 costumes. Theater magic revealed.

events.title: Glass water
events.text: Dawn paddleboarding: the lake like glass, loons for company.

effects.tpl: Sunrise miles before work. Days start victorious.
Tree pose on water. Falls are soft and hilarious.

events.title: Canvas week
events.text: A painting retreat in the hills: easels, wine, no agenda.

effects.tpl: Seven canvases, two great. A new identity: painter.
Thirty sketches. The hills live in your bag now.

events.title: Care years
events.text: A parent needs help now. Real help, scheduled weekly.

effects.tpl: Aides, schedules, dignity preserved. Love, administered.
Nearby apartment. Dinners together thrice weekly. Precious years.

events.title: Brine business
events.text: Your pickles win the fair. Strangers offer cash.

effects.tpl: Crunchy empire. 1,800 dollars of fermented gold.
Holiday jars for all. Your pickles grace forty tables.

events.title: Prime dink
events.text: Your knees approve of exactly one sport now.

effects.tpl: Tournament semifinals. The kitchen is yours.
Beginner clinics monthly. The sport grows because of you.

events.title: Second oven
events.text: The first oven was practice. The second feeds the street.

effects.tpl: Open invites, endless dough. The street runs on Fridays.
Every kid stretches their own. Flour wars declared weekly.

events.title: Stitch history
events.text: Grandmother's quilt top waits thirty years for backing.

effects.tpl: Quilted, bound, gifted. Three generations under one blanket.
Six learners, one tradition saved. The frames hum again.

events.title: Arm's length
events.text: Menus blur. The pharmacist suggests the inevitable drawer of glasses.

effects.tpl: Proper prescription. The world returns to focus.
Glasses everywhere: kitchen, car, desk. Never squint again.

events.title: Quarter century
events.text: 25th reunion. Name tags, old songs, new knees.

effects.tpl: You dance like it is senior year. Knees file a complaint.
You run the weekend. 200 people thank you by name.

events.title: River days
events.text: Three days downriver, camps on sandbars, stars overhead.

effects.tpl: Rapids giggled through, herons saluted. River time: timeless.
Dutch-oven feasts nightly. Paddlers paddle harder for your dinners.

events.title: Dawn patrol
events.text: The rowing club launches at 5:30am. Mist included.

effects.tpl: Synchronized power at sunrise. The boat flies silent.
One shell, one sunrise, total peace.

events.title: Skipper ticket
events.text: Sailing courses run all summer at the lake club.

effects.tpl: Certified skipper. Sunsets now have sails.
Reliable rail crew. Every captain wants you.

events.title: Heat and ice
events.text: The gym adds sauna and cold plunge. Members swear by it.

effects.tpl: Heat, ice, repeat. Sleep deepens, aches fade.
Thursday sauna club. Deals and confessions in the heat.

events.title: Sun harvest
events.text: Solar quotes land. The roof faces south like it was planned.

effects.tpl: Bills crater. The meter spins backward on sunny days.
A share of the town array. Clean power, zero ladders.

events.title: Ladle shift
events.text: The kitchen needs a Friday lead. Apron provided.

effects.tpl: Two years of Fridays. Hundreds fed, dozens housed.
Your drives fill the pantry thrice yearly.

events.title: Dark sky trip
events.text: The desert dark-sky preserve during meteor peak.

effects.tpl: The Milky Way casts shadows. Silence has texture.
Tracked exposures reveal color the eye misses. Gallery wall grows.

events.title: Channel curious
events.text: Someone mentions channel swimming. Your pilot license of madness tingles.

effects.tpl: Hour-long cold swims. Respect for the channel: total.
Six swimmers, one boat, shared glory. The channel bows.

events.title: Teen keys
events.text: Your teen passes the test. The car keys have never been heavier.

effects.tpl: Clear rules, tracked app, trust with guardrails. All survive.
Thirty days of co-pilot. They drive like you now. Carefully.

events.title: Aperture fever
events.text: A twelve-inch telescope lists used. Saturn awaits.

effects.tpl: Rings, bands, distant galaxies. The driveway becomes an observatory.
Monthly star parties. You run the big scope for crowds.

events.title: Strings at last
events.text: A used cello, evening lessons, forty years of wanting.

effects.tpl: Bach suites, slowly. The sound fills the house like honey.
Last chair, first joy. The orchestra welcomes late bloomers.

events.title: Ultra curious
events.text: A 50k trail race loops the mountains you love.

effects.tpl: You finish at dusk, headlamp on, soul blazing. Ultra: done.
Aid station captain at mile 20. Runners remember your soup.

events.title: Rails of Europe
events.text: Twenty years married. The sleeper trains wait.

effects.tpl: Eight cities, one compartment, endless breakfasts. The marriage glows.
Slow river, old towns, zero packing. Perfection floats.

events.title: Barn find
events.text: A 1972 coupe sits in a barn, priced like a dare.

effects.tpl: Two years later: chrome, thunder, trophies. Worth every cent.
Cleaned and sold to a dreamer. 2,500 dollars profit.

events.title: Palate school
events.text: A six-week wine course meets Thursdays. Spittoons provided.

effects.tpl: You blind-taste regions now. Dinners gain commentary.
Pairing menus mastered. Hosting level: legendary.

events.title: Sawdust era
events.text: The garage becomes a woodshop. The first project: a bench.

effects.tpl: Tables, chairs, a crib for the grandkids. Heirlooms daily.
Wooden toys for the shelter. A hundred smiles per batch.

events.title: Teacher training
events.text: Two hundred hours to teach. Your practice is ready.

effects.tpl: You teach dawn classes. Students glow because of you.
Advanced training only. The mat becomes a temple.
